title: 第21章 突破二境元海第22章 生死战
content_zh:
仙笼世界里，余烬再度回到那个熟悉的被黑雾填满的地方。
“你运气真好，它本来可以选择继续沉睡下去的，这样或许还有机会复活，可惜她选择了消耗最后的生命去帮你，真是一个伟大的器灵。”面具不无讥讽地说道。
“本尊知道你依旧渴望力量，开放你身体的控制权，本尊会让你君临天下！”
面对面具的诱导，余烬选择了直接无视，他扫了眼依旧在沉睡的不死雀，最后目光落在旁边的一块空地上。
布满红色纹路的草芥剑，正插在地面上，一团拳头大小的白光在环绕飞舞，光团之中骇然是一尊微型的三目白虎！
而在虎雀之间，一株一人高的灵株正在摇曳着身姿，紫色的枝干上已然长出了第八枚叶子，一朵妖艳至极的花苞正含苞待放！
哪怕还没有长出第九叶，可余烬隔着老远都能感觉到一股摄人心魄的魂力，在空间中徐徐荡漾，他开始有点期待真正的九叶摄魂花成熟会是什么样子！
余烬径直绕开九叶摄魂花，走到了草芥剑前，然后盘膝坐下，缓缓闭起眼睛。
如今顺利捕获了白虎真魂，他并不打算继续浪费时间，要立即进行肉身修炼法的第二重突破！
“可能是因为你我之间建立了神契的缘故，本尊的力量在你身上几乎融合得很完美，只可惜这萤火之躯，无法完全承受浩日之光，连杀个人都费劲……”
面具飞到了余烬身边，循循诱导：“你要是能突破第二重修炼法，也是好事，下次你的肉身就能承受本尊更多的力量！”
余烬伸出一只手，一把捉住面具，将其远远地甩飞出去，可下一秒面具又凭空回到了不死雀头上。
笑脸面具上微光闪动，却是没有发怒，因为神契在，他的确奈何不了余烬，除非后者愿意借助他的力量，他才能趁机夺取控制权。
他并不担心余烬会因为上次夺舍而变得谨慎，因为他知道人类是贪得无厌的，只要一个人还活着，他就需要更加强大的力量，尤其是余烬这类人！
他甚至隐隐期待余烬越来越强才好，这样游戏玩起来才更有趣！
而沉浸在突破修炼当中的余烬，并不知道面具在想什么，他也懒得去想，他余生剩下的目标只有一个，就是不断地往前走……找到娘亲……保护妹妹……掀翻那些所有拦在路上的阻碍！
当无名肉身锤炼法在体内缓缓运转的时候，若是有人可以内视余烬的身体，便会发现此刻的他整个人就像是一座巨大的熔炉，每一块肌肉和骨骼，甚至是五脏六腑都在暴动！
草芥剑上，那头微型的三目白虎像是感应到了什么，突然朝着余烬发出一声惊人的虎啸！
下一秒，三目白虎的一缕魂力，化作一道白芒嗖一声没入了余烬体内。
一股骇人听闻的凶戾气息，开始从余烬体内缓缓散发而出，他的双眼出现一圈白色的眼影，骨骼开始转换成白玉色，并且哔哩啪啦地作响，如雷鸣在不断敲击！

余烬的身躯不断在变大，身上本就破烂不堪的黑袍被撑得粉碎，露出如刀削一般的身材，他每一块肌肉变得越发轮廓分明，还隐隐有着白光流转。
面具像是淡淡地扫了一眼，“啧，仙笼三年的锤炼倒是一点没白挨，突破肉身二重的痛苦居然像是个没事人一样？”
随着点点滴滴的流逝，大概两个时辰之后，余烬猛地睁开双眸，那双黑眸下多了两道充满暴戾之气的白色，似乎隐隐产生了某种不为人知的异变，一股强大的肉身气息在空间中荡漾！
余烬站起身，那瞬间仿佛有一头猛虎虚影在背后苏醒，他忍不住一拳向前递出，腰间那一枚白玉牌同时发出微光！
拳锋所过，似有虎啸声传来，空气中骇然炸起一声爆鸣！
肉身修炼法，成功突破到第二重，甚至拥有了一些白虎血脉的特征!
content_en:
In the fairy cage world, Ember once again returned to the familiar place filled with black mist.
"You are so lucky. It could have chosen to continue sleeping, so that it might have a chance to resurrect. Unfortunately, she chose to spend her last life to help you. She is really a great weapon spirit." The mask said sarcastically.
"I know that you still long for power. If you open up the control of your body, I will let you dominate the world!"
Faced with the temptation of the mask, Yi Yan chose to ignore it. He glanced at the still sleeping Phoenix, and finally his eyes fell on an open space next to him.
The Caoji sword covered with red lines was stuck on the ground, and a ball of white light the size of a fist was flying around. In the light ball was a miniature three-eyed white tiger!
Among the tigers and birds, a spiritual plant as tall as a person is swaying. The eighth leaf has already grown on the purple branches, and an extremely charming flower bud is in bud!
Even though the ninth leaf has not grown yet, Ember can feel a breathtaking soul power from a long distance away, slowly rippling in the space. He is beginning to look forward to what the real Nine-leaf Soul-Absorbing Flower will look like when it matures!
Ember walked straight around the Nine-leaf Soul-Absorbing Flower, walked to the Caoji Sword, then sat down cross-legged and slowly closed his eyes.
Now that he has successfully captured the true soul of the White Tiger, he does not intend to waste time anymore and immediately makes the second breakthrough in the physical cultivation method!
"Maybe it's because of the divine contract established between you and me that my power is almost perfectly integrated in you. It's a pity that this body of fireflies cannot fully withstand the light of the sun. It's even difficult to kill someone..."
The mask flew to Ember and followed the instructions: "It would be a good thing if you can break through the second level of cultivation. Next time, your body will be able to withstand more of my power!"
Ember reached out a hand, grabbed the mask, and threw it far away, but the next second the mask returned to the immortal bird's head out of thin air.
A faint light flashed on the smiling mask, but he was not angry, because with the divine bond, he really couldn't do anything to Ember. Unless the latter was willing to use his power, he could take the opportunity to seize control.
He is not worried that Yan Yan will become cautious because of the last time he took the body, because he knows that human beings are greedy. As long as a person is still alive, he needs more powerful power, especially people like Yan Yan!
He even vaguely hopes that Ember will become stronger and stronger, so that the game will be more interesting!
As for Yi Yan, who was immersed in breakthrough training, he didn't know what the mask was thinking, and he didn't bother to think about it. He had only one goal for the rest of his life, which was to keep moving forward... to find his mother... to protect his sister... to overturn all the obstacles that stood in his way!
When the nameless physical body tempering method is slowly operating in the body, if anyone can look inside the body of Yi Yan, they will find that his whole body is like a huge furnace at this moment, every muscle and bone, and even the internal organs are rioting!
On the Caoji sword, the miniature three-eyed white tiger seemed to sense something, and suddenly let out an astonishing tiger roar towards the embers!
The next second, a ray of soul power from the three-eyed white tiger turned into a white light and disappeared into the body of the ember.
A horrifying and ferocious aura began to slowly emanate from Ember's body. A circle of white eye shadow appeared in his eyes, and his bones began to turn into white jade, and they made a beeping sound, like thunder that was constantly beating!
Yan Yan's body continued to grow larger, and the tattered black robe on his body was shattered, revealing a knife-like figure. Each of his muscles became more and more defined, and there was a faint white light flowing.
The mask seemed to glance at it lightly, "Tsk, the three years of training in the immortal cage were not in vain at all. The pain of breaking through the second level of the physical body is actually like a normal person?"
As bit by bit passed, about two hours later, Yi Yan suddenly opened his eyes.There are two white streaks full of violence under the black eyes, as if some unknown mutation has occurred, and a powerful physical breath is rippling in the space!
Yi Yan stood up, and at that moment it seemed as if a tiger's shadow was awakening behind him. He couldn't help but punch forward, and the white jade medal around his waist shimmered at the same time!
As the fist passed by, there seemed to be a roar of a tiger, and there was a shocking explosion in the air!
The physical cultivation method successfully broke through to the second level, and even possessed some characteristics of the White Tiger bloodline!
